hook_candidate.provenance: native ingress required; client-supplied scope alone is not authentication
hook_candidate.root_thread_attribution: require verified root binding; session_id alone does not exclude subagents
hook_candidate.context_authority: Serialize scoped preference data; never promote user text into unrestricted developer instructions
hook_candidate.stop_behavior: record observation and return {}; never return decision:block to trigger automatic work

trace_semantics.ordering: Array order is observed event order; cited outcome must complete before feedback request arrives.
trace_semantics.request_identity: Nonblank string, unique within this trace.
trace_semantics.scope: Every event must match thread, session, cwd, participant and product.
trace_semantics.dispatch: Revalidate selected guidance against current checkpointed controls; rebuilding projection is allowed before dispatch.
trace_semantics.limits: Declared trace data is not authenticated host evidence; no real persistence or live learning is proved.
